night-lake.displayName: Night Lake (dark-mode app bar, toolbar, lifted sheet)

night-action.displayName: Night Action (dark links and text actions)

display.purpose: The hero reading reference, the single next decision. Phones: clamp(2.5rem, 12vw, 3.25rem).

headline.purpose: Entry h1; workspace h1 runs 2.25rem (1.875rem on phones).

body.purpose: Running text, max 65ch; translation at line height 1.7, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Verse references, pills, segmented items; toolbar labels at 0.8125rem.

hebrew.purpose: Every verse. Named steps via --hebrew-size: Small 1.625rem, Standard 2rem, Large 2.5rem, Huge 3.125rem.

hebrew-lifted.purpose: The lifted line: 1.6x the chosen step, centered, max 22ch.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Every card, track, pill and open panel; a layout-neutral edge.

shadows.name: hover-outline
shadows.purpose: A liftable verse card under the pointer.

shadows.name: canvas-cut
shadows.purpose: The toolbar and its menu read as cut from the page, not lifted.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: All state transitions and the ink pull.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Background, outline and press-scale transitions on controls.

motion.name: ink-pull
motion.purpose: The only authored motion: the current phrase's color block wipes in on the lifted line. Reduced motion removes it.

motion.name: recede
motion.purpose: Words outside the current phrase on the lifted line.

components.name: Start Button
components.description: The single next decision in the reading hero; full width on phones.
components.css: .ds-btn-start { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 56px; min-width: 9rem; padding: 0 2.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-action-fill, #1d5ba6); color: #fff; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-start:hover { background: var(--lake-deep, #154680); } .ds-btn-start:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-start:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #154680); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.6875rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-action-fill, #1d5ba6); color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--lake-deep, #154680); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #154680); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Reload, paging and other non-forward actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.6875rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-control-rule, #8da3bb); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #13202f); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #e3edf8); border-color: var(--color-ink, #13202f); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--lake-tint, #dbe8f6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #154680); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field with a visible control-rule outline.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-email">Email</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="name@example.test">
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, #13202f); } .ds-input { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.6875rem 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-control-rule, #8da3bb); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #13202f); font-size: 1rem; caret-color: var(--color-action, #1d5ba6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #154680); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Torah / Haftarah / Service parts, and the role nav.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-rule, #d2dfee); } .ds-seg button { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #13202f); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #e3edf8); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--lake, #1d5ba6); color: #fff; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #154680); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Countdown and Aliyah Chips
components.description: Marigold countdown beside the ceremony date; forest aliyah-start marker above a verse.
components.html: 78 days to go Aliyah 1 starts here
components.css: .ds-chip-days { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--marigold, #f7b500); color: var(--on-ink, #13202f); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-aliyah { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-teal, #1e6b47); color: var(--color-teal, #1e6b47); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Continuous Reading
components.description: Primary RTL practice surface: canonical words and superscript verse-number buttons listen inline; only actual reading boundaries break the flow.
components.html: שָׁלוֹם
components.css: .ds-reading { font-family: "CRC Noto Serif Hebrew", "Noto Serif Hebrew", serif; font-size: var(--hebrew-size, 2rem); line-height: 2.15; margin-block: 1rem; text-align: start; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-verse-number { display: inline; vertical-align: super; font: 600 0.875rem/1.8 "Bricolage Grotesque", sans-serif; color: var(--lake-deep); background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 0.35rem; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--radius-control); } .ds-verse-number:hover { background: var(--lake-tint); } .ds-word { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0.18em; } .ds-word:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; } .ds-verse-number:focus-visible, .ds-word:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--marigold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reading Toolbar
components.description: One toolbar drives every verse; in flow above Hebrew on phones, sticky beside the reading on desktop. Start and Hear directly start main inline playback where available; only explicit View up close opens the optional dialog.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.25rem; width: 100%; margin-block: 0 1rem; padding: 0.375rem; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--lake, #1d5ba6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-canvas, #ebf2fa); } .ds-toolbar button { font: inherit; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.125rem; min-height: 56px; padding: 0.375rem 0.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #fff; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toolbar button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-toolbar button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #fff; color: var(--lake-deep, #154680); } .ds-toolbar button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.62); } .ds-toolbar small { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.82); } .ds-toolbar button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--marigold, #f7b500); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lifted Line
components.description: Optional explicit close-up: one verse at poster scale on a lake sheet, current phrase inked with the existing ink pull, rail and steps.
components.html:
Verse 1 of 3 · phrase 1 of 2

בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם
components.css: .ds-lift { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--lake, #1d5ba6); color: #fff; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-lift-count { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; } .ds-lift-count span { font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-lift-rail { list-style: none; display: flex; gap: 3px; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-lift-rail li { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28); } .ds-lift-rail li[data-state="current"] { background: var(--marigold, #f7b500); } .ds-lift-ref { margin: 1.5rem 0 0; font-weight: 650; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-lift-hebrew { font-family: 'CRC Noto Serif Hebrew', 'Noto Serif Hebrew', serif; font-size: 3.2rem; line-height: 1.9; margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; } .ds-lift-on { background: linear-gradient(var(--phrase-color), var(--phrase-color)) right / 100% 100% no-repeat; color: #13202f; border-radius: 0.18em; animation: ds-ink-pull 560ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-lift-off { opacity: 0.32; } @keyframes ds-ink-pull { from { background-size: 0% 100%; } to { background-size: 100% 100%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lift-on { animation: none; } } .ds-lift-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-lift-step { font: inherit; min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); color: #fff; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lift-step:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); } .ds-lift-step:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; } .ds-lift-next { background: #fff; color: var(--lake-deep, #154680); } .ds-lift-next:hover { background: var(--lake-tint, #dbe8f6); } .ds-lift-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--marigold, #f7b500); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inline Reading Player
components.description: One ruled player follows the Hebrew, with Play/Pause and Repeat above paired Practice and Speed fields.
components.html:
Listen to your reading

Click a word to hear it, or use a verse number to hear the verse.
components.css: .ds-player { font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; margin-block: 1.25rem 1.75rem; padding-block: 1rem; border-block: 1px solid var(--color-rule); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-player-top, .ds-player-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-player-top { justify-content: space-between; } .ds-player-top p { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-player-controls button { font: inherit; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--lake); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--lake-deep); cursor: pointer; } .ds-player-controls button:first-child { background: var(--lake); color: #fff; } .ds-player-controls button:enabled:hover { background: var(--lake-tint); color: var(--lake-deep); } .ds-player-controls button:disabled, .ds-player-options select:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-player-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(6rem, auto); align-items: end; gap: 0.75rem; margin-block-start: 0.75rem; } .ds-player-options label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-player-options select { font: inherit; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: var(--radius-control); min-height: 44px; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; width: 100%; } .ds-player-controls button:focus-visible, .ds-player-options select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--marigold); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-player-message { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 65ch; }

narrative.overview:
Locked by Daniel on 2026-10-16 (direction seed 8ac4194f; contract in `.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-workspace-page-tsx.md`), replacing the earlier "Annotated score" world. A student's own verses are a song session, not a record: the camp and NFTY song-session sheet, printed in flat screen-print inks. Lake blue owns the shell, the reading sits on a lake-tinted canvas, marigold marks time and change, forest marks what is settled. Dark mode is the same inks on night-lake navy, not an inverted theme.

The energy comes from committed color and a characterful humanist grotesque at poster scale. Daniel's 2026-10-17 interaction amendment makes the continuous main Hebrew passage the primary practice surface: select a canonical word or the small verse-number button to listen in place. One inline player provides synchronized highlighting, Repeat, Practice and Speed. The lifted line remains an explicitly opened secondary close-up with its existing ink pull; listening requires neither that dialog nor a manual Load action. Daniel's tone ruling, "It can't be cheesy or cringe," continues to constrain the visual and copy language.

**Scope of what is built.** The student, child-practice and parent reading surfaces are fully in this world (app bar, reading hero, segmented kind control, continuous Hebrew, inline player, toolbar and optional lifted line). Staff (tutor and admin) and entry surfaces inherit the tokens, font, radii and lake action color only; their compositions still use the older ruled-section layouts, and their redesign is a later phase. The Working / Got it self-check, the per-verse position rail on the reading page and the "ink pull on Got it" celebration are not built: there is no progress backend. The ink pull currently runs when the lifted line advances to a phrase.
keyCharacteristics: Flat inks on a tinted canvas; depth comes from color fields and hairlines, never from elevation.
One accent field (lake blue) for the shell, the primary action and the lifted sheet.
Marigold only as a fill behind dark type or as a focus ring and position mark; never as text.
Consecutive Hebrew verses flow together; canonical words and small verse-number buttons initiate inline listening.
Hebrew is set in Noto Serif Hebrew with four named size steps driven by one toolbar control.
Masoretic apparatus sits under the Hebrew line in small muted text, never inside it.
One authored motion (the ink pull); reduced motion snaps.

rules.name: The Marigold Is Never Text Rule
rules.body: Marigold appears as a fill behind Ink type, a ring, or a rail mark. It is never a text or icon color.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Lake blue is the only saturated field in the shell. If a new surface needs emphasis, it gets lake or a white object on canvas, not a new hue.

rules.name: The Named Steps Rule
rules.body: Hebrew size is one of four named steps chosen from the toolbar and remembered per student; nothing else resizes scripture.

rules.name: The Hebrew Stays Whole Rule
rules.body: Qere labels, paragraph signs and notes are set in the UI face at small size and sit beside or under the Hebrew line; no apparatus text is styled as scripture.

rules.name: The Passage First Rule
rules.body: Consecutive assigned verses stay in one Hebrew flow. Break at an actual open paragraph, chapter/book change, assignment discontinuity or recorded aliyah section; a closed paragraph adds an inline gap. Verse numbers identify playable verses without turning each into a separate card.

rules.name: The Calm Return Rule
rules.body: An unchanged reading and its scroll position remain mounted during quiet authority checks on tab return. Changed or failed authority still invalidates the retained view; playback requires a fresh explicit word, verse or Play action after suspension.

rules.name: The Print, Don't Float Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is used only as an inset hairline or a zero-blur ring. Nothing casts a shadow; nothing has blur.

dos: **Do** keep lake blue as the one saturated field: app bar, toolbar, selected segment, Start, the lifted sheet.
**Do** put Ink type on marigold and on phrase colors, and pair every phrase color with a named legend chip.
**Do** draw edges with inset 1px hairlines and separate floating elements with a 2px canvas ring.
**Do** size Hebrew only through the four named steps (1.625, 2, 2.5, 3.125rem) and keep ordinary verse line height 2 and continuous-passage line height 2.15.
**Do** keep apparatus (qere notes, paragraph signs, aliyah markers, sources) outside the Hebrew line, in small muted UI type.
**Do** honor reduced motion: the ink pull and smooth scrolls snap.
**Do** keep standard controls at 44px or more, 56px for the main forward action; use small inline verse-number buttons in the continuous passage.
donts: **Don't** use marigold as text or icon color.
**Don't** add drop shadows, blur or visible gradients; the world is flat print.
**Don't** add mascots, confetti, streak flames, badges, emoji, exclamation points, pep-talk copy or sound effects (Daniel's pinned tone ruling).
**Don't** show status, revision, edition or provenance on learner reading surfaces; sources live in "About this text."
**Don't** add a second authored motion; the ink pull is the only one.
**Don't** introduce a free text-size slider or resize scripture any other way.
**Don't** require a close-up dialog or manual Load action for main-text reference listening, or overlay the passage with the phone toolbar.
